question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 20, 30 and 60 days, respectively. A works every day. B assists A on all odd-numbered days, while C assists A on all even-numbered days. In how many days will the work be completed?
solution:
**Given:**

A do a work = 20 days

B do a work = 30 days

C do a work = 60 days

A works everyday

B assists A on all odd-numbered 

C assists A on all even-numbered 

**Concept used:**

Efficiency = Total work done/ No. of days

**Calculation:**

As A works 20 days , B works 30 days and C works 60 days 

Let the total work unit be L.C.M(20,30,60) is 60 unit 

Efficiency of A = 60/20 = 3 unit/day
